Footer.tagline: A character apartment in the heart of Wimereux, steps from the Opal Coast.

Hero.subtitle: A character apartment steps from the seafront, where the salty breeze drifts through the windows.

Logement.label: The apartment
Logement.p1: Nestled within Villa La Valkyrie, L'Atelier des Sardines is an apartment designed for those who want to truly experience Wimereux — far from soulless hotels, close to everything that matters.
Logement.p2: Its name? A fond tribute to the working-class and maritime history of the Opal Coast — right down to the large sardine fresco adorning the living room wall.
Logement.p3: Fully renovated, the apartment blends the spirit of the Opal Coast with refined contemporary comfort: new insulation, premium bedding, fully equipped kitchen. All the charm of the seaside, without the downsides of older properties (damp, draughts).
Logement.p4: A 5-minute walk from the seafront, shops and the train station. The sea is at the end of the street.

Couchages.label: Sleeping
Couchages.sofa_desc: A top-quality sofa bed that transforms into a genuinely comfortable bed. Soft mattress, bed linen provided.
Couchages.alcove_desc: A bed tucked between two partitions creates an intimate, cosy alcove. Quality mattress, soft lighting. A perfect cocoon to recharge to the sound of the seagulls.
Couchages.baby_desc: A baby cot is available on request to welcome little ones in the best conditions. Mention it when booking.

Equipements.label: Amenities
Equipements.desc: L'Atelier des Sardines is designed for complete independence — you won't need to buy or borrow anything.
Equipements.cuisine_desc: Oven, microwave, hob, fridge, coffee maker, kettle and everything else you need.
Equipements.lv_desc: Because holidays mean no washing up by hand.
Equipements.ml_desc: For longer stays or remote working — pack light, wash on site.
Equipements.bureau_desc: A dedicated workspace with a fold-down desk, perfect for a day of remote working.
Equipements.wifi_desc: Reliable connection for video calls, streaming or remote work.
Equipements.seche_desc: Your towels always warm and dry, even in the wettest season.
Equipements.linge_desc: Quality sheets and towels provided for every stay.
Equipements.bienvenue_desc: Coffee, tea and a few little extras to start your stay on the right foot.
Equipements.jardin_desc: A fully enclosed garden, no overlooking. Rare in Wimereux — make the most of it!
Equipements.terrasses_desc: A relaxation terrace and a south-facing garden terrace. Sun all day long.
Equipements.animaux_desc: Your pet is welcome. The enclosed garden gives them freedom in complete safety.
Equipements.bebe_desc: A baby cot is available on request to welcome little ones.

Exterieur.label: Outdoor
Exterieur.desc: Enjoy a fully enclosed outdoor space, with two terraces positioned to catch the sun from morning to evening — and from several spots in the garden, a glimpse of the sea between the houses.
Exterieur.atout1_desc: A garden all to yourselves — lawn, gravel path and brick wall. No overlooking, and from several spots in the garden you can glimpse the sea in the distance.
Exterieur.atout2_desc: A relaxation terrace on the street side, a garden terrace facing south. The sun follows you all day — with a sea view in the background.
Exterieur.atout3_desc: Your companion is welcome. The enclosed garden is perfect for giving them freedom in complete safety.

Teletravail.label: Remote work friendly
Teletravail.desc: L'Atelier des Sardines is designed for digital nomads and remote workers. Enjoy the Opal Coast without sacrificing productivity — or the other way around.
Teletravail.avantage1: Dedicated wall-mounted desk, ergonomic and well-lit
Teletravail.avantage2: High-speed fibre WiFi for video calls
Teletravail.avantage3: Absolute quiet during the day, off-season
Teletravail.avantage4: Fully equipped kitchen to cook and save money
Teletravail.avantage5: Beach 5 min away to unwind between meetings
Teletravail.avantage6: Train station 5 min away — Boulogne-sur-Mer in 10 min by train

CTAReservation.label: Booking
CTAReservation.desc: Book directly on Airbnb to check availability and secure your stay in Wimereux.
CTAReservation.price_note: Low season, excluding Airbnb service fees

LivretHero.title: Guest Guide
LivretHero.subtitle: L'Atelier des Sardines — Wimereux
LivretHero.desc: Everything you need for a perfect stay. Access this guide on your smartphone at any time.

SectionBienvenue.title: Welcome!
SectionBienvenue.p2: We are Manu & Amélie, and we are delighted to welcome you to this apartment that means so much to us. We fell in love with Wimereux and its wide beaches, and we wanted to create here a comfortable place where you will feel right at home.
SectionBienvenue.p3: Whether you've come for walks along the seafront, sunsets over the sea or simply to rest — enjoy every moment, including the private enclosed garden and its two terraces, available exclusively for you.
SectionBienvenue.wifi_password: 🔑 The password was sent to you by text message — you can also find it in the printed guest guide available in the apartment.
SectionBienvenue.tip: We hope the fresh sea air of the Opal Coast does you the world of good. We wish you wonderful moments in Wimereux! 🌞

SectionAcces.title: Access & parking
SectionAcces.flexible_tip: Early check-in or late check-out possible subject to availability — contact Manu on 07.81.81.08.69 in advance.
SectionAcces.keys_p1: The key box is located on the garden access gate, on the right side of the villa.
SectionAcces.keys_p2: The key box code was sent to you by text message before your arrival.
SectionAcces.parking_p: Parking is free on the street in front of the property. Enjoy!
SectionAcces.ev1: Carrefour Market de Wimille — a few minutes by car
SectionAcces.train1: From Paris Gare du Nord: TER Côte d'Opale to Boulogne-sur-Mer (~2h30)
SectionAcces.train2: Connecting TER or bus to Wimereux train station
SectionAcces.train3: From Wimereux station: 5-minute walk to the apartment

SectionRegles.title: House rules
SectionRegles.intro: A few simple rules to ensure a great stay for you, your neighbours and future guests.
SectionRegles.rule0: No smoking anywhere in the property
SectionRegles.rule1: Please respect the neighbours and keep noise down, especially after 10 PM
SectionRegles.rule2: Don't slam the door when entering or leaving
SectionRegles.rule3: No unannounced guests — maximum capacity is 4 people
SectionRegles.rule4: No illegal activities on the premises
SectionRegles.rule5: Please sort your waste (see Waste section)
SectionRegles.rule6: Pets welcome! The enclosed garden is available for them — please pick up after your pet on the lawn
SectionRegles.rule7: The sofa and bed are not reserved for pets
SectionRegles.rule8: No smoking inside — please smoke in the garden and collect your cigarette ends
SectionRegles.rule9: Please put outdoor furniture back after use

SectionCanapeLit.title: The sofa bed
SectionCanapeLit.intro: The sofa bed is in the living room. It comfortably sleeps 2 people with its top-quality mattress.
SectionCanapeLit.couette: The duvet is in the living room unit
SectionCanapeLit.oreillers: The pillows are in the sofa bed's internal storage
SectionCanapeLit.unfold0: Remove the sofa cushions and set them aside
SectionCanapeLit.unfold1: Pull the strap located at the centre of the sofa backrest
SectionCanapeLit.unfold2: Unfold the mattress by pulling the frame towards you until it is flat
SectionCanapeLit.unfold3: Fetch the duvet from the living room unit and the pillows from the internal storage
SectionCanapeLit.fold_title: How to fold it back on departure
SectionCanapeLit.fold1: Put the duvet back in the living room unit
SectionCanapeLit.fold2: Fold the mattress back by pushing the frame towards the sofa
SectionCanapeLit.fold3: Return the seat to sofa position and replace the cushions
SectionCanapeLit.tip: Please fold the sofa bed back before departure — see the checklist in the Checkout section.

SectionAlcove.title: The alcove
SectionAlcove.intro: The alcove is an intimate, cosy space, designed as a true retreat. The bed is set between two partitions, creating the atmosphere of a ship's cabin — perfect for sleeping to the imaginary sound of the waves.
SectionAlcove.literie_p: The bed will be made up on arrival with clean sheets and pillows. An extra blanket is in the living room unit.
SectionAlcove.eclairage_p: Wall lights are fitted in the alcove, with integrated sockets to charge your phone or any other device without leaving the bed.
SectionAlcove.rangements_p: Hangers are available at the partition edge, just at the entrance to the alcove, to hang your clothes within easy reach.

SectionCuisson.title: The oven & microwave
SectionCuisson.micro_manual: The full instruction manual is in the cupboard above the microwave.
SectionCuisson.micro0: Place your dish in the microwave (no metal or foil!)
SectionCuisson.plaques_p: The hob is ceramic. Wait until it has completely cooled before cleaning.
SectionCuisson.raclette_p: Fancy some comfort food on a cold day? Candle raclette pots are available for you!
SectionCuisson.raclette2: 2 to 3 candles are needed for good heat
SectionCuisson.plancha_p: An electric plancha is available in season for grilling — ideal on the terrace.
SectionCuisson.warning: Never leave the hob on unattended. Check it is switched off before leaving the kitchen.

SectionLaveVaisselle.title: The dishwasher
SectionLaveVaisselle.intro: The dishwasher is already filled with salt and rinse aid. A tablet is available — the one with powder is for the dishwasher (not the washing machine).
SectionLaveVaisselle.step0: Roughly rinse the dishes and load them
SectionLaveVaisselle.step1: Place a tablet in the door compartment
SectionLaveVaisselle.step3: Close the door — it starts on its own!
SectionLaveVaisselle.step4: Slightly open the door at the end of the cycle to let the dishes dry
SectionLaveVaisselle.tip: The dishwasher starts automatically once you close the door after pressing Power. No need to press Start.
SectionLaveVaisselle.warning: Do not put kitchen knives, wooden items or the coffee maker in the dishwasher — wash them by hand.

SectionMachineALaver.title: The washing machine
SectionMachineALaver.intro: Detergent pods are available — the pod for the washing machine is the one without powder (not the dishwasher one). A clothes airer is also available.
SectionMachineALaver.step0: Load the laundry, not exceeding 3/4 of the drum capacity
SectionMachineALaver.step1: Place a pod directly in the drum (not in the tray)
SectionMachineALaver.step2: Select the programme: Cotton 40°C for everyday use, Delicate for underwear
SectionMachineALaver.step4: Remove the laundry as soon as the cycle ends to avoid creases
SectionMachineALaver.etendage_p: A clothes airer is available in the apartment.
SectionMachineALaver.tip: Please avoid running a wash at night out of consideration for the neighbours.

SectionSecheServiettes.title: Bathroom & linen
SectionSecheServiettes.sdb_item1: A set of towels per person is available in the bathroom
SectionSecheServiettes.sdb_item2: The hairdryer is in the bathroom cabinet
SectionSecheServiettes.seche_p: The heated towel rail instructions are posted directly in the bathroom.
SectionSecheServiettes.fer_p: The iron and ironing board are in the living room unit.
SectionSecheServiettes.warning: Never completely cover the heated towel rail — this blocks air circulation and may cause the device to overheat.
SectionSecheServiettes.tip: On departure, please leave used towels on the bathroom floor.

SectionCuisine.title: The kitchen — inventory
SectionCuisine.intro: The kitchen is fully equipped. You will also find coffee, tea and herbal tea pods for your relaxation breaks.
SectionCuisine.cat1_item1: Coffee, tea, herbal tea & sugar pods provided
SectionCuisine.cat2_item1: Ice pack available in the freezer (for picnics!)
SectionCuisine.tip: A supermarket and shops are on Rue Carnot, 5 min on foot. The market is held on Tuesday and Friday mornings at Place Albert 1er (off-season).

SectionDechets.title: Waste sorting
SectionDechets.intro: In Wimereux, waste sorting is mandatory. The bins are at the entrance of the villa — you can't miss them.
SectionDechets.bac1_freq: Every other week (alternating with the blue bin)
SectionDechets.bac1_contenu: Plastics, cardboard, metal tins, food cartons
SectionDechets.bac2_freq: Every other week (alternating with the yellow bin)
SectionDechets.info: Yellow and blue bins collected on alternate Wednesdays — if unsure, check which bin your neighbours put out the evening before.
SectionDechets.tip: Glass recycling columns (bottles & jars) available at Place Foch.

SectionDepart.title: Checkout checklist
SectionDepart.checkout_note: Check-in from 3:00 PM for the next stay
SectionDepart.checklist0: Return the sofa bed to sofa position and replace the cushions
SectionDepart.checklist1: Leave used towels on the bathroom floor
SectionDepart.checklist2: Empty the fridge of your food
SectionDepart.checklist3: Empty and/or run the dishwasher before leaving
SectionDepart.checklist4: Take out the bins and empty them
SectionDepart.checklist7: Pick up pet waste from the lawn (if you have a pet)
SectionDepart.checklist8: Put outdoor furniture back if you used it
SectionDepart.checklist10: Close all windows and the door
SectionDepart.checklist11: Leave the keys in the key box
SectionDepart.late_info: Late check-out available on request — contact Manu the evening before on 07.81.81.08.69.
SectionDepart.review_title: A small gesture that makes a big difference ✨
SectionDepart.review_p1: If you had a good stay, please know that on Airbnb, 5 stars simply means "everything went well". Your rating helps us enormously to continue this adventure.
SectionDepart.review_p2: If anything could be improved, please let us know directly — your feedback is precious ❤️
SectionDepart.goodbye:
Thank you for your stay! 🐟
We hope to see you again very soon.

SectionContacts.title: Useful contacts
SectionContacts.info: An automated medical dispenser is available outside Pharmacie Degrave, open 7 days a week, 24 hours a day.

SectionAlentours.title: Around — our favourites
SectionAlentours.intro: Here are our recommendations to make the most of Wimereux and the Opal Coast. Happy exploring!
SectionAlentours.tip: In summer, Wimereux gets busy at weekends. For a quieter beach experience, head out on weekdays or early in the morning.
